questions.cardText:
[Anthropology] Which of the following best describes ethnocentrism?
A. In-group bias in resource allocation
B. Interpreting another culture by the standards of one’s own culture
C. The belief in the superiority of one’s ethnicity
Answer: B.
questions.de: Wie nennt man es, eine andere Kultur nach den Werten und Maßstäben der eigenen Kultur zu beurteilen?
questions.en: What is the term for judging or interpreting another culture by the values and standards of one’s own culture?

timeline.labelEn: William Graham Sumner defines ethnocentrism in his book Folkways
timeline.labelDe: William Graham Sumner definiert in seinem Buch „Folkways“ den Ethnozentrismus

questions.notes: Reversed into a term question. Wikipedia notes the word is also used for option C’s sense (belief that one’s own culture is superior), so the card’s choice of B is the core definition rather than the only one.

questions.cardText:
[Earth Science] What is the highest mountain in North America?
A. Mount McKinley (Denali)
B. Mount Logan
C. Mount Saint Elias
Answer: A. Located in Alaska, Mount McKinley is the highest peak in North America with an elevation of 20,310 feet (6,190 meters) above sea level. It is renowned for its dramatic size and spectacular natural beauty.
questions.de: Wie heißt der höchste Berg Nordamerikas, der sich in Alaska 6190 m hoch erhebt?
questions.en: What is the highest mountain in North America, rising 6,190 m (20,310 ft) in Alaska?

timeline.labelEn: Hudson Stuck, Harry Karstens, Walter Harper and Robert Tatum make the first verified ascent of Denali
timeline.labelDe: Hudson Stuck, Harry Karstens, Walter Harper und Robert Tatum gelingt die erste belegte Besteigung des Denali

questions.notes: Card correct. Name history: officially Denali 2015–2025; since January 2025 the US federal government designates it Mount McKinley again (Alaska keeps Denali), so both names are accepted.
